arxiv-2104-11921.title: Non-reciprocity and quantum correlations of light transport in hot atoms via reservoir engineering
arxiv-2104-11921.creator: Xingda Lu, Wanxia Cao, Wei Yi, Heng Shen, Yanhong Xiao
arxiv-2104-11921.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xingda Lu, Wanxia Cao, Wei Yi, Heng Shen, Yanhong Xiao. The breaking of reciprocity is a topic of great interest in fundamental physics and optical information processing applications. We demonstrate non-reciprocal light transport in a quantum system of hot atoms by engineering the dissipative atomic reservoir. Our scheme is based on the phase-sensitive light transport in a multi-channel photon-atom interaction configuration, where the phase of collective atomic excitations is tunable through external driving fields.

arxiv-2211-05158.title: Modular linear differential equations for four-point sphere conformal blocks
arxiv-2211-05158.creator: Ratul Mahanta
arxiv-2211-05158.description: Abstract mahanta@bo.infn.it, tsengupta@imsc.res.in Abstract We construct modular linear differential equations (MLDEs) w.r.t. subgroups of the modular group whose solutions are Virasoro conformal blocks appearing in the expansion of a crossing symmetric 4-point correlator on the sphere. This uses a connection between crossing transformations and modular transformations.

arxiv-2410-06615.title: QA-Calibration of Language Model Confidence Scores
arxiv-2410-06615.creator: Putra Manggala, Atalanti Mastakouri, Elke Kirschbaum & Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan, Aaditya Ramdas
arxiv-2410-06615.description: Abstract To use generative question-and-answering (QA) systems for decision-making and in any critical application, these systems need to provide well-calibrated confidence scores that reflect the correctness of their answers. Existing calibration methods aim to ensure that the confidence score is on average indicative of the likelihood that the answer is correct.

arxiv-2504-00303.title: Karabo: A versatile SKA Observation Simulation Framework Journal: Astronomy & \& Computing
arxiv-2504-00303.creator: Rohit Sharma, Simon Felix, Luis Fernando Machado Poletti Valle, Vincenzo Timmel, Lukas Gehrig, Andreas Wassmer, Jennifer Studer, Pascal Hitz, Filip Schramka, Michele Bianco, Devin Crichton, Marta Spinelli, André Csillaghy, Stefan Kögel, Alexandre Réfrégier
arxiv-2504-00303.description: Abstract Karabo is a versatile Python-based software framework simplifying research with radio astronomy data. It bundles existing software packages into a coherent whole to improve the ease of use of its components. Karabo includes useful abstractions, like strategies to scale and parallelize typical workloads or science-specific Python modules.

arxiv-2509-02982.title: StableSleep: Source-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Sleep Staging with Lightweight Safety Rails
arxiv-2509-02982.creator: Hritik Arasu, Faisal R. Jahangiri
arxiv-2509-02982.description: Abstract Sleep staging models often degrade when deployed on patients with unseen physiology or recording conditions. We propose a streaming, source-free test-time adaptation (TTA) recipe that combines entropy minimization ( Tent ) with BatchNorm statistic refresh and two safety rails: an entropy gate to pause adaptation on uncertain windows and an EMA-based reset to reel back drift.

arxiv-2511-20251.title: PromptMoG: Enhancing Diversity in Long-Prompt Image Generation via Prompt Embedding Mixture-of-Gaussian Sampling
arxiv-2511-20251.creator: Bo-Kai Ruan, Teng-Fang Hsiao, Ling Lo, Yi-Lun Wu, Hong-Han Shuai
arxiv-2511-20251.description: Abstract Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) generation have achieved remarkable visual outcomes through large-scale rectified flow models. However, how these models behave under long prompts remains underexplored. Long prompts encode rich content, spatial, and stylistic information that enhances fidelity but often suppresses diversity, leading to repetitive and less creative outputs.

The son of a rabbinical scholar, he was educated in Hebrew literature and history, and subsequently in law and philosophy at the university of Berlin. From 1860 to 1866 he was professor in the university of Berne, and subsequently returned to Berlin as professor of philosophy in the kriegsakademie (1868) and later in the university of Berlin (1873).

pmc-12564055.title: Cervical Oculopathy: The Cervical Spine Etiology of Visual Symptoms and Eye Diseases—A Hypothesis Exploring Mechanisms Linking the Neck and the Eye
pmc-12564055.creator: Ross A. Hauser, Morgan Griffiths, Danielle Matias, Benjamin R. Rawlings

pmc-12742130.title: Clinical usefulness of tools used for screening and measuring frailty in the ambulance and emergency department in older people: a scoping review protocol
pmc-12742130.creator: Carl Magnusson, Nellie Wahlstedt, Linda Östlundh, Anne Wissendorff Ekdahl, Karin Hugelius, Lisa Kurland
pmc-12742130.description: AbstractIntroductionAs people age, frailty becomes increasingly prevalent and is associated with adverse outcomes, including higher risks of hospitalisation, institutionalisation and mortality. Early identification of frailty in ambulance and emergency department (ED) settings may support clinical decision-making and help predict outcomes for older patients.

pmc-13359467.title: Healthcare Transition From Pediatric to Adult Care Among Youth Living With HIV in South Carolina: Retrospective Study From 2005 to 2021
pmc-13359467.creator: Fanghui Shi, Huiyi Xia, Katherine E Weaver, Xiaoming Li, Bankole Olatosi, Sharon Weissman, Rebecca Widener, Xueying Yang
pmc-13359467.description: Purpose:As more youth with HIV (YWH) survive into adulthood, successful healthcare transition (HCT) from pediatric to adult care is crucial for optimal health outcomes. This study aimed to characterize YWH transition status and identify individual- and county-level predictors.Methods:Statewide HIV surveillance data in South Carolina were used for analysis.

pmc-13482592.title: Intravesical mycobacteria reshape bladder and gut microbiota in a murine bladder cancer model
pmc-13482592.creator: Víctor Campo-Pérez, Sandra Guallar-Garrido, Raúl Cabrera-Rubio, Paula Herrero-Abadía, Arnau Seguí-Moll, Manuela Torres-Puente, Pablo Cano-Jimenez, Iñaki Comas, Eduard Torrents, Esther Julián
pmc-13482592.description: The bladder microbiota may influence tumor progression and responses to intravesical therapies, yet the effects of Mycobacterium bovis BCG instillations on bladder and gut microbiota remain unexplored. This study evaluates, for the first time, the impact of M. bovis BCG and Mycobacterium brumae, a non-pathogenic immunomodulator, on microbiota composition in bladder tissue and cecal stool of healthy and tumor-bearing mice.

pmc-13540805.title: Spatiotemporal trends in food deserts, food swamps and food environments around schools in Wallonia, Belgium (2008–2024)
pmc-13540805.creator: Nicolas Cammue, Nicolas Berger, Fanny Pandolfi, Stefanie Vandevijvere
pmc-13540805.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundFood environments influence dietary behaviors and nutritional health outcomes. Food deserts, areas characterized by limited spatial access to healthy foods, and food swamps, areas where unhealthy outlets predominate, present challenges to the adoption and maintenance of a healthy diet. This study analyzed trends in access to healthy and unhealthy food environments in neighborhoods and around schools in Wallonia, Belgium, over the period 2008–2024.
